title: Fault-injection fixture for a failed save in release_engram_begin_preparation_hold_for_resume, and a rollback test for the expired-pending Resume
outcome: Tests can make the Resume release's commit_locked fail. A test shows that a Resume releasing an expired, never-sent pending begin, whose save fails, restores the head's evaluate (with its prepared begin), bind, dispatch generation, rebind flag and lineage, including pending_grant_id, and returns the 'could not be released' error with nothing sent.
acceptance: Fault-injection fixture for a failed save in release_engram_begin_preparation_hold_for_resume, and a rollback test for the expired-pending Resume is done
